title: PocketBase
description: An open source backend in 1 single binary file consisting of embedded SQLite database, realtime subscriptions, file storage, and an elegant admin dashboard.
features: Single executable binary written in Go with embedded SQLite database
Realtime websocket event subscriptions with fine-grained collection rules
Built-in authentication with OAuth2 providers (Google, GitHub, Discord, Apple)
Local disk or S3-compatible file storage with automatic thumbnail generation
Extensible as a Go framework or via server-side JavaScript hooks
pros: Zero DevOps complexity: run `./pocketbase serve` and your backend is live
Tiny memory footprint (< 30MB RAM idle) running effortlessly on a $4/mo VPS
Extremely clear documentation and clean SDKs (JS/TS, Dart, Python)
cons: Single-node SQLite means vertical scaling only; no multi-region clustering
Limited complex relational queries compared to full PostgreSQL
targetAudience: Mobile developers, solo creators, and rapid prototyping teams needing a backend in minutes.
